chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Muskān, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who doubts while he is standing and does not know whether he has performed rukuʿ or has not performed rukuʿ. He said: He performs rukuʿ and prostrates.
ai.seo_question: What should a person do in salat (prayer) if he doubts while standing whether he has performed rukuʿ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt during salat (prayer). If a person is still standing and becomes unsure whether he has performed rukuʿ, he should perform the rukuʿ and then continue to sajdah.
